name: Stromgarde Badges
summary: In Stromgarde, the Syndicate is fighting a contingent of militia, and its leaders pay gold for every badge taken from a fallen militiaman. At Refuge Pointe, Captain Nials wants those badges recovered.

sections.title: A Bounty on Soldiers
sections.body: In Stromgarde the Syndicate is at war with a contingent of militia. To push their followers into fighting the better-trained soldiers, Syndicate leaders pay gold for each badge taken from a slain militiaman. Captain Nials calls them cutthroats and will not let them keep trophies of the brave fallen, so you are sent into the Syndicate-held part of Stromgarde to hunt for the badges and bring them back to Refuge Pointe. Nials wants the Syndicate to learn it cannot profit from the dead.

sections.title: After the Hunt
sections.body: Nials promises that the relatives of the fallen will be told they died in battle. The news is grim to deliver, but Nials judges it better than leaving a family to wonder what became of a missing relative.

faq.q: Why does the Syndicate want Stromgarde badges?
faq.answer: Their leaders have put a bounty on the militia: gold for every badge taken from a militiaman who has fallen, meant to push the Syndicate's followers into fighting the better-trained troops.
Captain Nials sends you into the part of Stromgarde the Syndicate controls to hunt them for the badges.

faq.q: Who orders the retrieval of the badges?
faq.answer: Captain Nials, at Refuge Pointe, who does not want the Syndicate keeping trophies from the fallen militia.
